messages.campaign_fixture.quest.variants.title: Campaign fixture: the waystation gate
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.variants.descript: Decide whether to welcome visitors or seal the waystation. Your choice changes this shared location.
campaign_fixture.quest.variants.offer.li: Visitors are approaching. Should we keep the gate open or seal it?
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.variants.choose.l: What should happen to the gate?
campaign_fixture.quest.variants.choose.l: This decision will change the waystation for everyone.
We can reopen the gate now. This will remove our barricade.
campaign_fixture.quest.variants.report.l: The decision has been recorded. Everyone shares this outcome.
